projects.title: ThreatLens
projects.desc: AI-assisted application-security triage for CI/CD. Ingests scanner findings (Semgrep / SARIF), de-duplicates and clusters them into vulnerability classes, then uses an LLM to adjust severity, flag false positives, and generate remediation — with defenses against prompt injection. Outputs a live interactive dashboard and SARIF for GitHub Code Scanning.

projects.title: ADATT — Identity Security Automation
projects.desc: A commercial platform that automates secure employee offboarding across hybrid Active Directory + Microsoft 365 — account disable, full MFA/FIDO2 teardown, session/token revocation, license reclamation, and compliance-grade audit reporting. Built end-to-end with least-privilege OAuth and encrypted, no-credential-storage design.

projects.title: Identity Lifecycle Governance
projects.desc: Audit-driven automated onboarding/offboarding for IT-admin and MSP contexts across Active Directory, Entra ID, and Exchange Online — closing orphaned-account and standing-access risks that are a primary lateral-movement vector.

projects.title: AI Feedback Application
projects.desc: An AI application that collects and analyzes customer feedback to improve AI-agent behavior — applying AI development coursework to a working prototype.

recommendations.quote:
Jose was a critical part of the small and powerful IT/MIS team at ChildNet Inc. During his time there I was grateful to benefit from his expertise. While his role at the time was Management Support Specialist II, he proved his abilities as a system administrator and security professional.

He designed a clear plan to increase the Windows Server functional domain level from 2003 to 2012. His plan prevented any confusion during the upgrade process. The upgrade happened with no service disruption thanks to his clear plan. Jose also prevented a loss of productivity during a Cisco switch failure. At the time, a core switch failed and brought the main office to a halt. Our network services contractor was unable to respond immediately. Jose then volunteered his skills to login and reconfigure another switch to act as a replacement. The office was back online within an hour.

Jose's last major accomplishment I want to highlight is high work with our computer re imaging workflow. Thanks to his research with the Microsoft provided tools, ChildNet was able to reduce our computer setup time from 1 day to less than an hour. This is also improved our inventory from a few desktops and laptops to more than 20 at any time. This was all done with minimal capital expense.

Jose accomplished these and many other great projects while still excelling as a Management Support Specialist II who received 30-50 tickets per day.
